description: Lieux de covoiturage - SCOT du Seuil du Poitou is a dataset listed in transport.data.gouv.fr, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte pour l'Aménagement du Seuil du Poitou. Open carpooling area data for CA Grand Châtellerault, CC des Vallées du Clain, CC du Haut Poitou, CU du Grand Poitiers. Coverage: CA Grand Châtellerault, CC des Vallées du Clain, CC du Haut Poitou, CU du Grand Poitiers. The portal lists 1 resource (csv) and files the dataset under the type "carpooling-areas". The portal shows 2025-02-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-france-transport-data-gouv-national-access-point.
